2609.11724.title: The Eloquence submission for Task 2 of the Interspeech 2026 MLC-SLM challenge
2609.11724.paper_summary: This paper details the Eloquence team's approach to Task 2 of the 2nd MLC-SLM challenge at Interspeech 2026, which involves multilingual Multiple-Choice Question Answering (MCQA) across 21 languages. Three approaches are explored. First, we fine-tune Voxtral-Mini-3B via LoRA with cross-lingual data augmentation, ASR transcript augmentation and timestamp-aware audio cropping, achieving 0.72 macro-accuracy on evaluation Phase 2. Second, we apply multimodal in-context learning (ICL) to the frozen Voxtral-24B model to correct a strong label bias, reaching 0.81, our best result. Third, a training-free retrieval system based on a three-layer voice-anchored memory combining acoustic identity, semantic content, and a knowledge graph achieves 0.68. All three systems substantially outperform the official baseline.
2609.11724.paper_summary_zh: 這篇論文詳細介紹了Eloquence團隊在2026年Interspeech的第二屆MLC-SLM挑戰賽中對任務2的處理方法，該任務涉及21種語言的多語言多選題回答（MCQA）。我們探討了三種方法。首先，我們通過LoRA對Voxtral-Mini-3B進行微調，並結合跨語言數據增強、ASR轉錄增強和時間戳感知的音頻裁剪，在評估階段2中達到0.72的宏觀準確率。其次，我們將多模態上下文學習（ICL）應用於凍結的Voxtral-24B模型，以修正強標籤偏差，達到0.81，這是我們的最佳結果。第三，基於三層語音錨定記憶的無需訓練的檢索系統，結合了聲學身份、語義內容和知識圖譜，達到0.68。這三個系統的表現均顯著超過官方基準。
